openQuestionAnswers: Android Q1 (widthPx vs PNG width; grep logcat in §5?): `Modifier.width(canvasWidth)` fixes the Box's px width to `canvasWidth.roundToPx()` == `widthPx`, and PixelCopy's `bounds` come from `onGloballyPositioned` on the SAME node, so `size.width` in the draw scope equals the PNG width unless the parent's max constraint is narrower than the canvas (a device narrower than 390dp) — exactly the case the Log.w names. YES: the §5 refresh should run `adb logcat -d | grep 'Harness label chrome:'` and stop on any hit; test-all.sh already greps logcat for `Capture run config:` (lines 1116-1130), so adding this grep there is a small tooling follow-up.

Move it to the :app command or simply run the whole :app suite (127 tests, ~2 s executed with --rerun).

reverify.verdict: RE-VERIFY: the MUST-FIX is CLOSED with executed evidence and no regression was found — gate-ready on the web half. BLOCK_LABEL_FILL = 'rgba(237, 237, 237, 0.706)' composites to the natives' (174,174,180) in the capture pipeline's Chromium (my independent probe puts the byte-180 window at [0.704, 0.7078] — Chromium rounds the CSS alpha to 8 bits at the .5 boundaries — so 0.706 sits mid-window with ~0.002 margin each side; the bytes match a premultiplied-source-truncated model exactly: 237·179/255→166 + 26·76/255→7 = 173 at byte 179, 167+7 = 174 at byte 180). The colour pin is no longer vacuous: apps/web-harness/tests/ui/LabelChrome.raster.test.tsx pushes the REAL CaptureGallery markup through headless Chrome with the capture flags and is red on both old spellings (M1 0.70196 and M2 0.7 → (8,6) = [173,173,179], 117 / 1116 band mismatches; my extra 0.71 → [175,175,181]); the CI skip path was executed both ways (empty PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR → 4 skipped exit 0; LABEL_CHROME_RASTER_REQUIRED=1 → exit 1).
